scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when choosing a charity to support with our hackathon proceeds?

options.name: Code.org Education Access Fund
options.upside: Supports expanding computer science education nationwide
options.tradeoff: Funds primarily go to curriculum development, less direct aid
options.concern: May not address immediate social needs outside education

options.name: Doctors Without Borders Emergency Relief
options.upside: Provides urgent medical care in disaster and conflict areas
options.tradeoff: Funds may be used in unpredictable, high-risk environments
options.concern: Less transparency on specific project outcomes

options.name: National Alliance on Mental Illness
options.upside: Raises awareness and provides support for mental health issues
options.tradeoff: Impact is harder to quantify and slower to manifest
options.concern: Some may feel mental health is less urgent than physical aid
options.best_for: prioritizing mental health awareness and support

options.name: World Wildlife Fund Conservation Projects
options.upside: Supports biodiversity and combats climate change
options.tradeoff: Benefits are long-term and indirect for human communities
options.concern: May be seen as less relevant to immediate human needs

shared_context: The total donation amount is fixed at $5,000
The goal is to maximize positive impact with the donation
